name: my-collection
description: Multi-tenant application with Angular client and NestJS server

scripts.client:dev: cd client && npx nx serve client
scripts.client:serve: cd client && npx nx serve client --prod
scripts.client:build: cd client && npx nx build client
scripts.client:test: cd client && npx nx test client
scripts.client:lint: cd client && npx nx lint client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.install:force: npm install && cd client && npm install --force && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run client:build && npm run server:build
scripts.test:all: npm run client:test && npm run server:test
scripts.lint:all: npm run client:lint && npm run server:lint
scripts.clean: rimraf client/node_modules server/node_modules node_modules client/dist server/dist
